title: Cost User Usage Item
description: Tenant-scoped per-user aggregate returned by GET /api/v1/costs/users.

input_tokens.description: DISJOINTNESS CONVENTION: EXCLUDES cache_read_tokens. Providers disagree natively -- Bedrock reports cache reads disjointly from inputTokens while OpenAI reports them as a SUBSET of prompt_tokens -- so producers normalize to the disjoint convention before emitting this field. A consumer multiplying this by a rate is pricing FRESH input only and must price cache_read_tokens separately at the cache-read rate. Records written before 5.7.0 may carry the provider-native convention and are NOT distinguishable by this field alone; see the 5.7.0 CHANGELOG entry.
